description: This Java class 'AjaxResponse' provides a structure for creating JSON responses, including status, data entries, validation messages, and error handling, for AJAX calls in a web application.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class that constructs a JSON response object for AJAX interactions, encapsulating status, data, validation messages, and error info.

methods.name: getValidationMessages
methods.description: Returns the map of validation messages.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry to the response data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the status message based on an exception's message.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets the status message directly from a string.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Generates the JSON string representation of the response.
